image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at the left of a small table, holding a pen beside a closed spiral-bound notebook at center. The notebook is upright, resting its lower edge on the table, with the cover facing the viewer. Its left spiral binding and complete rectangular cover outline are clearly visible; the cover is blank black. Keep hands beside rather than over the cover. The white OpenAI knot floats to the right. Calm end-of-work discussion. No clocks, words or extra notebooks.

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线插画，一个火柴人和一个可辨认的 OpenAI 六环结标识，无底图文字。竖立的纸质螺旋笔记本封面和装订完整可见，无可读交接内容。 准确无扩张裁剪发现初稿右/下缘过紧，已按1254原图像素位置重新归一化并保留小余量；不改变词义与对象指代。
